title: Queue-lane count column collides with the next lane letter for any q >= 10 at 18px
evidence:
+				bx := px + 52 + i32(lane) * 108
+				draw_mono_c(v, lane_name, bx, ty, NOC_SIZE_LABEL, NOC_LABEL)
...
+				noc_bar(v, bx + 22, ty + 8, 70, f32(q) / f32(bound), level)
+				draw_mono_c(v, fmt.tprintf("%d", q), bx + 22 + 70 + 4, ty, NOC_SIZE_BODY, NOC_TXT_DIM)
 --- and the diff's own digit metric: ---
+	// the units stay put as counters tick). 18px Plex Mono digit ≈ 10.8px,
detail: Count text starts at bx+96; the next lane letter sits at bx+108, leaving a 12px budget. At the diff's own 10.8px/digit, two-digit queue depths (the congested states this panel exists for) overrun into the next lane's letter. The 84px ledger pitch got a pinning test; the 108px queue pitch did not.
recommended_fix: Widen the lane pitch or shrink the bar so count text clears the next lane letter at max queue depth; extend noc_column_math_seats_the_18px_digits to cover the queue-lane pitch.

title: noc_visible_rows_math_at_720 re-implements the visible-row formula instead of exercising the production expression
evidence:
+	visible := i32((v.win_h - NOC_CONTENT_Y - NOC_CONTENT_BOTTOM) / NOC_ROW_H)
+	testing.expect(t, visible == 23, "23 visible rows at 1280x720 (574px / 24px rows)")
 --- production line it claims to pin: ---
-	visible := i32(NOC_PANEL_H / NOC_ROW_H)
+	visible := i32((v.win_h - NOC_CONTENT_Y - NOC_CONTENT_BOTTOM) / NOC_ROW_H)
detail: The test copies the draw_noc_panel expression verbatim, so it pins only the constants' arithmetic — a future edit to the production formula (e.g. different inset) leaves this test green while the panel diverges.
recommended_fix: Extract the visible-row computation into a shared proc used by both draw_noc_panel and the test, mirroring the noc_panel_rows single-source pattern.
